record.title: quantum nano-automata
record.name: QuantumNanoAutomata
record.content:
\textbf{Description:} A \emph{quantum nano-automaton} or \emph{(quantum nano-computer)} is realized as a microphysical nano-device represented by a quantum automaton that is also capable of quantum computation involving, for example, a field of computations specified over a quantum groupoid. The latter can be realized as a locally compact (topological) groupoid, topological semi-group;in the more general case, it can be defined over a \emph{quantum algebraic category}, quantum algebroid or a higher dimensional algebraic structure (as previously defined in higher dimensional algebra).
\textbf{Note:} Quantum nano-automata possess intrinsic, extended quantum symmetries defined by quantum groupoid or quantum algebroid representations
